name: Flowernet
summary: Reported local Kalgoorlie ISP; flowernet.com.au was Hawkins Nursery + a member-login portal (ISP branding) 1997-2011; domain parked by Jan 2014, since deleted. No APNIC record.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of flowernet.com.au (Oct 1997; local source places it in Kalgoorlie).
Site dead ~2011; domain parked Jan 2014, later deleted.
